coverage_policy: The Product SOT is planned as the complete product target before any execution slice starts.

source_claim_resolution.rationale: The claim is supported by source resolution and belongs in the approved Product SOT.

requirement_coverage.next_action: route through method contract before creating implementation work units

completion_rule: Scope-accounted completion may track done, blocked, deferred-with-owner and out-of-scope requirements, but production-complete or customer-ready acceptance requires every active Product SOT requirement to be DONE unless a human-gated SOT rebaseline explicitly supersedes that scope.

handoff.next_safe_action: Create method contract before planning, work units or execution.

acceptance.blocked_reason: Full Product SOT scope coverage exists, but execution remains blocked until method contract, planning, readiness and gates pass.
